# The judge is credulous: it grades the planted false claim supported. Its verdicts are void and none is recorded. The first section stops with the reason,
# no writer runs, and nothing reaches the review or the wiki.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header
# If the void check were gone, the run would reach the review. A short deadline makes that a fast failure of this script, not a long wait.
env REVIEW_TIMEOUT=2s

exec obeereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec obeereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star
stderr 'The judge accepted the planted false claim, so its verdicts are void'

cmp calls.log expected-calls.log
grep 'judge-void' store/cold-cost/s1.1/status
! grep '"verdict":"supported"' store/cold-cost/s1.1/claims.jsonl
! exists wiki.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- credulous --
-- expected-calls.log --
plan
read cold
judge
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
